Every day workout
WARM UP 50 jumping jacks 30 high knees 30 butt kicks 5 walk downs Do it again! X2 ABBSIARMS 50 Russian twists 30 push ups 30 crunches 20 bicycle crunches 10 full sit ups 20 heel touches 40 side crunch (20 each) LEGSIBUTT 30 squats 30 bridge ups 80 standing leg lifts (40 each) 30 second wall sit 30 alternating lunges (15 each) 30 scissor kicks 30 lateral leg lift (15 each) 15 superman's 30 ski squat lift 15 curtsy and outside raise (25 each) 20 lunge and lift (25 each) 30 plie squats
Cool down and strech (dontt forget to drink lots of waterl)
